checked_classes: Spec violations — acceptance_criteria is null, so there are no concrete criteria in the packet to validate against.
Correctness — the diff only appends one JSONL telemetry/event record and does not modify executable logic.
Regressions — no existing code, configuration semantics, or migration contents are changed by the diff.
Security — the added event includes an absolute local project_root path, but similar absolute paths already exist in the adjacent file context and no packet constraint prohibits recording them.

Constraint breaches — the diff does not import adapter crates, add unwrap/expect, log JWT/claims/relation tuples/tenant identifiers, add dependencies, modify pgrx crates, add clippy allows, or affect other listed blocking constraints.
Silent failure — no error handling or fallback behavior is introduced or changed.
